privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Paint by Moonlight uses the camera to take a photo you can turn into a paint-by-numbers picture. The photo stays on your device.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Paint by Moonlight saves a painting or its time-lapse to your photo library when you choose Save Image or Save Video as you share it.
